bars.says: On a Contagion map the player meets wet alien ground, flesh-shaped plants and distinct living natives beneath the red storm, with building ground and no native food supply.

meant.intent: The biome must be a place to inhabit rather than a tinted vanilla forest or an empty showcase; ordinary native movement and recognizable failed biology are its land and life.
meant.source: delegated: from the_contagion.md sections 1, 4, 5 and 9; English grotesque cast sitting CONTAGION_RULED_CONTENT_1; naming tiers and no-forage bans.

accept: Rain gleams on alien sand beside eyed trunks, halfmade alien plants and moving skin flyers; a player builds a roof on dry ground and brings food from elsewhere.
The smaller Zhool'Iza reads as a smaller distinct native beside the zhool; malformed Unfinished bodies and their health descriptions agree.
reject: A red filter covers recognizable oak woodland, native harvest feeds colonists, or only placed display animals inhabit an otherwise empty map.
A pictured skin flyer only walks, a native silhouette is replaced by a missing-texture square, or ground is impassable everywhere a refuge could be built.
bars.lazy: A red filter covers recognizable oak woodland, native harvest feeds colonists, or only placed display animals inhabit an otherwise empty map.

range.varies: Full maps 150x150, 250x250 and 325x325; authored peak/valley, river/no river, sparse/normal/dense canopy; young/mature/blighted flora; every admitted race and whole-body graphic alternative; 0, 4 and 40 colonists; day 1, day 30 and day 100 snapshots. Roster evidence is parsed from the current XML, not an old cast count.
range.left_out: No planet repaint or generated planet; no new flavour abilities inferred from silhouettes; animal meat/forage tuning counts are not acceptance thresholds.

bars.says: Through a season of ordinary colony life in the Contagion, the player repeatedly reads the red storm and its warning, shelters or makes a costly useful crossing, manages changed bodies and returns for tissue while native births and readable deaths continue without a flood, an emptied valley, a stalled cycle or an error storm.

figurative.accept: The red river can overflow visually while native bodies and work routes remain usable.

figurative.stands_for: repeating runtime exceptions or notices without corresponding new events
figurative.accept: Rain and thunder can be continuous while the runtime log remains clean.

accept: The colony builds refuges, reads natural warnings, collects a useful batch, arrests a touched worker and sees the valley renew failed life; the same activities still work after a mid-season reload and in a different order.
Ordinary local crowding or an accidental lost animal leaves readable consequences without filling all work routes, erasing the living cast or repeating errors and messages without new events.
reject: The staged dash works while natural Burns, shared Rupture growth or corpse processing are locked off, then the unrestricted valley floods with hosts and remains.
The full colony can only stay indoors, the sky never tears or closes, the cast disappears, or reload duplicates batches and starts repeated errors.

range.varies: Full 250x250 and 325x325 authored valley maps for 15 normally simulated in-game days (a season); colony 4 and 40, sparse/normal/dense canopy with reachable and obstructed routes; ordinary default natural gap/duration RNG seeds including endpoints. Save on day 7 during a non-idle active transition. Orders: acquire host -> inject -> crossing/collect -> arrest; and exposure/arrest -> prepare refuges -> acquire/inject -> crossing/collect. Extend a representative naturally ticked save to day 100 to check accumulation. No wall-clock jumps; speed-up may render fewer frames but preserves all ticks, clocks, growth, jobs, damage and weather competition. Observe full cues at normal speed.

checks.what: Parse post-patch roster as XML elements: present explicit densities, zero forage/food path, owned terrain, disease references, guarded RustPuff, no legacy TentacularPlant acquisition; verify all referenced defs resolve under composed package. Numbers are regression facts, not bars.

Current Bloom accuracyMultiplier 0.4 is the standing exception: retain it; Burn ordinary accuracy 1.0. Record all gap/duration/tell/transition data and weather sun factor; no heatKind/heatOffsetC per biome. No inferred climate from old exported tile census.

Record actual deck weights, allNegativeShare 0.5, min severity 0.1, mutation cap 6 and eligible entry/part mapping from current data. Every cost/benefit metadata claim must have a separately verified applied effect; changing numeric tuning alone does not reopen bars.

Read actual MaxFlightTime, cooldown, race flags and directional flip-book paths; report absent frames as implementation work without pinning an animation-frame count. Verify atlas and guarded VEF bodies without unattended flight.

Field initializers, Scribe fallbacks, persisted clean-config load, group reset and suite DEFAULTS agree with proposed settings contract; all extras production and acquisition off. Old active-save state is readable.

Current normal count uniform 2-4 and pool of kidney/liver/lung/heart/natural arm/natural leg, independent draws with replacement; compute advertised odds from resolved pool. Record donor-ID and once-only completion, output placement and vanilla surgery success witnesses.

Record observed path travel, actual pressure intervals, weather arrival, birth/hatch/unravel timers, stage persistence, notice rate and render-event edges; never accept deadline jumps as elapsed time.

Record native size/speed/tools, death action classes, growth/food eligibility and variant paths for regressions, not passing thresholds; keep roster admissions and no eviction, including multi-homed rows.
Shared scanner targets only existing enabled phenomena; no default Coalescence heartbeat; quiet/pod/wreck/cave reads remain valid. Validate actual package guard, not inferred submod PackageId.
No default planet-scoring/rarity capability; no legacy edible donor acquisition. Dormant def resolution is compatible with old saves and does not count as activated feature.
Loads and clean log, settings floor and assembly/def/patch references including shared engines. A failed check is builder evidence, never its own refusal bar.

rules.rule: Design Version 0.1.0 retains exactly census kept rows. Deferred code/defs stay, all production, acquisition and UI gates default off and labelled next version. No planet generation, scoring/rarity UI or local-world authoring is permitted. All DLC and composed mandrake.rm.biomes assumed.

Consume one shared geometric shade/exposure service for Burn pressure, tells-time route selection and exposure, including ruled water. Remove local exact-tree predicate and biome heatKind/heatOffsetC. Direct Sun stays the shared vanilla heat path; BurnDose is distinct UV injury, never a new heat system. Parasols consume shared cover; water is not automatically safe from illness.

Keep natural scheduling saved across load, tell state continuous and pressure gated by actual Burn weather arrival; no random WeatherDecider Burn. Wet lulls stay covered storm intervals, not surprise clear Burns. Proposed ordinary budding is allowed during covered intervals only, suspends in Burn, resumes without catch-up burst.

Forecast response runs during tells; reuses shared path/shelter engine with job provenance and reachable candidate fairness. No teleport. Drafted/downed/manhunter exceptions retain consequences; Scorchpod takes harm without compelled dive; Scaldhide/Crispling come out. Shared sun escape reads weather-scaled exposure and cannot thrash/cancel an active valid pre-Burn refuge job.

A dash means a purposeful ordinary trip within the declared route/health envelope, not a new ability, quota or safe distance law. Combined BurnDose, vanilla Heatstroke, rain movement and touched exposure determine cost. Near-work warning guarantee depends on reachable route; impossible routes are readable failures.

Use only kept contact source Unfinished plus Bloom/Burn sky doses for eligible humanlike flesh. Early warning precedes mutation; once-per-progression onset notice is saved; actual new mutation notices remain. Exposure stops with removal of cause, existing progression continues until arrested; shaded contact is still contact.

Keep the ruled half all-negative/half benefit-with-cost draw, eligibility fallback, no duplicate entry on the same pawn and current finite cap. Benefits/costs must actually apply. This is no benefit-only card, not a scalar utility proof; no new deck tuning is pinned by bars.

Retain Sunbeam item, ordinary purchase/reward access and ordinary weak projectile path with the independent native-damage bonus disabled and no Bloom accuracy exemption; medical success requires full reachable reserved hold, visible beam and injury, preserves mutations, grants no immunity. Cancellation changes nothing. Do not revive special Helix trade to supply treatment.

Ordinary batch includes current natural organs and natural arms/legs, not exotic limbs. Show actual pool, random-count distribution and wanted-part chance before commit; current independent draws with replacement: chance at least one target is sum over count probability times (1-(1-p_target)^count). Save donor and completion identity. Commit sample only on successful injection; never kill host for a healthy completion until a whole legal output placement is secured or a readable blocked-birth state retains that entitlement. Premature death loses batch once with a sign.

Use stable donor/pawn/transaction IDs through load, death and absent donor; never use display names as identity. Natural-arm/leg restoration and matched mood stay; exotic abilities/removal defer. Match bonus only after successful ordinary surgery, no mismatch penalty.

Death creates one owned chain of physical remains. Goo classes use non-butcherable recognizable remnant, skin then anatomical print instead of persistent ordinary corpse; acid classes preserve acid event and a trace; birth preserves no-acid exception. Consumption requires actual eater arrival; sampling is inspectable anatomical record independent of Draftprint trade. Proposed print persistence at least one ordinary return trip (check tuning in M4); butchery, fire, sampling and consumption serialize claims to avoid duplicate products. Ridge departures leave husks; player corpses remain vanilla.

Keep admitted animal/plant bodies and ordinary vanilla diet/tools/behaviour; no roster evictions. Keep smaller commissioned Zhool'Iza as ordinary life with no added mechanic; art variants are checks. Existing host births/random malformation and finite unraveling remain. Do not infer new mechanics from poetic descriptions; specifically deferred behaviours are listed in next_version.md.

Do not redesign CreatureBehaviors, ExplosiveGrowth, EnvironmentalHazards, Wreckage or Bones. Keep their ordinary shipped settings and currently bound Rupture/growth/birth/death/loot behaviour in integration runs. Rupture-born hosts/jellies are distinct population producers; local spawner caps are not a map-wide bound. Scanner payload remains shared integration, no dormant Coalescence signal.

Floor: feature off stops new effects at its documented boundary, does not erase living pawns, installed health state, pending ordinary batch entitlement or prior remains. All-off leaves land/life and readable legacy state. No active extra may alter default proof. Toggle reads/deserialization/reset must agree; labels explain now/next event/reload effects; no new unsupported cross-biome switch.

Fictional flyers use real flight stats/tracker and whole-body directional flip-books; grounded floaters remain distinct. No unattended live flyer tests or flight screenshots. Offline definitions/frames first; runtime tracker testing follows the standing attendance restriction, visual flight only with owner.

meetings.why: Colours, silhouettes, tells, beam and remains read different objects/states; corpse staging replaces vanish, not live-body art. Roster and beam recognition still require the declared in-game looks. There is no numerical art-variant contract.
Weather arrival, tells lead, wet-lull exposure, pre-Burn jobs and load edge can disagree even when individual clocks pass. Need state walk through all overlaps before claiming joint lead.

Tree shadows, closed rooms, water, shared cover and job selection must agree; growth/death can invalidate a refuge between selection and arrival. Current exact-tree implementation is known contrary evidence.
